<div class="wash-widget">
  <svg
    class="wash-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 866 631"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Lavado - Lavadora Línea 2"
  >
    <defs>
      <!-- Contornos originales con esquinas redondeadas -->
      <clipPath
        id="wash3-tank-top-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="4"
          y="86"
          width="851"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="wash3-tank-middle-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="4"
          y="218"
          width="851"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <clipPath
        id="wash3-tank-bottom-clip"
        clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          x="3"
          y="351"
          width="852"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </clipPath>

      <!-- POLEAS: mismo metal satinado de los widgets anteriores -->
      <linearGradient
        id="wash3-roller-metal"
        x1="15%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="85%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2" />
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="43%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA" />
        <stop offset="74%" class="roller-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- CUBAS Y RECUADRO: reflejo metálico suave -->
      <linearGradient
        id="wash3-tank-metal"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="16%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="tank-metal-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Franjas azules -->
      <linearGradient
        id="wash3-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B3D9EE" />
        <stop offset="40%" class="tank-liquid-base" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#96C5E1" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- POLEAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="wash3-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%"
        y="-30%"
        width="160%"
        height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- CUBAS: sombra ambiental y sombra de contacto -->
      <filter
        id="wash3-tank-shadow"
        x="-3%"
        y="-35%"
        width="106%"
        height="185%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="2"
          result="tankAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankAmbientBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="2.5"
          result="tankAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.10"
          result="tankAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankAmbientColor"
          in2="tankAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.5"
          result="tankContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="tankContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="tankContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="tankContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="tankContactColor"
          in2="tankContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="tankContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="tankAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="tankContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra interior discreta de las franjas azules -->
      <filter
        id="wash3-liquid-inset"
        x="-2%"
        y="-20%"
        width="104%"
        height="140%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.7"
          result="liquidBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="liquidBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.8"
          result="liquidOffset"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="SourceAlpha"
          in2="liquidOffset"
          operator="out"
          result="liquidInnerEdge"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#315F79"
          flood-opacity="0.16"
          result="liquidShadowColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="liquidShadowColor"
          in2="liquidInnerEdge"
          operator="in"
          result="liquidInnerShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
          <feMergeNode in="liquidInnerShadow" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!--
      CUBAS

      Posiciones y dimensiones exteriores originales.
      Franjas azules desde la mitad de cada cuba.
      Margen lateral e inferior: 4 unidades SVG.
      Las cuerdas y poleas quedan por delante.
    -->
    <g class="tanks">
      <!-- Cuba superior -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#wash3-tank-top-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="4"
            y="86"
            width="851"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="8"
            y="104.5"
            width="843"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 11 87.2 L 848 87.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 11 121.8 L 848 121.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="4"
          y="86"
          width="851"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba intermedia -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#wash3-tank-middle-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="4"
            y="218"
            width="851"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="8"
            y="236.5"
            width="843"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 11 219.2 L 848 219.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 11 253.8 L 848 253.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="4"
          y="218"
          width="851"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Cuba inferior -->
      <g class="tank-group">
        <g clip-path="url(#wash3-tank-bottom-clip)">
          <rect
            class="tank-upper"
            x="3"
            y="351"
            width="852"
            height="37"
          />

          <rect
            class="tank-lower"
            x="7"
            y="369.5"
            width="844"
            height="14.5"
            rx="3"
            ry="3"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-top-highlight"
            d="M 10 352.2 L 848 352.2"
          />

          <path
            class="tank-bottom-shade"
            d="M 10 386.8 L 848 386.8"
          />
        </g>

        <rect
          class="tank-outline"
          x="3"
          y="351"
          width="852"
          height="37"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- CONDENSADO: recorridos originales -->
    <g class="condensate-system">
      <!-- Columna izquierda -->
      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 110 123 L 110 150 L 85 150 L 85 589"
      />

      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 110 255 L 110 283 L 85 283"
      />

      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 110 388 L 110 416 L 85 416"
      />

      <!-- Columna derecha -->
      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 495 123 L 495 150 L 469 150 L 469 589"
      />

      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 495 255 L 495 283 L 469 283"
      />

      <path
        class="condensate-line"
        d="M 495 388 L 495 416 L 469 416"
      />

      <!-- Colector principal -->
      <path
        class="condensate-line condensate-main"
        d="M 837 589 L 3 589"
      />
    </g>

    <!--
      VAPOR

      Tuberías interrumpidas en los cuerpos de las válvulas.
      Los retornos compartidos se dibujan una sola vez
      en color de condensado.
    -->
    <g class="steam-system">
      <!-- Subidas principales -->
      <path
        class="steam-line"
        d="M 92 548 L 92 169"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line"
        d="M 476 548 L 476 169"
      />

      <!-- Superior izquierda -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 92 169 L 129 169 L 129 157"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 129 139
          L 129 108
          L 119 118
          L 110 108
          L 110 123
        "
      />

      <!-- Central izquierda -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 92 302 L 129 302 L 129 290"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 129 272
          L 129 240
          L 119 250
          L 110 240
          L 110 255
        "
      />

      <!-- Inferior izquierda -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 92 435 L 129 435 L 129 423"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 129 405
          L 129 373
          L 119 383
          L 110 373
          L 110 388
        "
      />

      <!-- Superior derecha -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 476 169 L 514 169 L 514 157"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 514 139
          L 514 108
          L 504 118
          L 495 108
          L 495 123
        "
      />

      <!-- Central derecha -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 476 302 L 514 302 L 514 290"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 514 272
          L 514 240
          L 504 250
          L 495 240
          L 495 255
        "
      />

      <!-- Inferior derecha -->
      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="M 476 435 L 514 435 L 514 423"
      />

      <path
        class="steam-line valve-connection"
        d="
          M 514 405
          L 514 373
          L 504 383
          L 495 373
          L 495 388
        "
      />

      <!-- Colector principal -->
      <path
        class="steam-line steam-main"
        d="M 4 548 L 836 548"
      />
    </g>

    <!-- CONTROL: posiciones originales -->
    <g class="control-system">
      <!-- Superior izquierda -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 195 110 L 195 148 L 146 148"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="195"
        cy="110"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <!-- Central izquierda -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 195 243 L 195 281 L 146 281"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="195"
        cy="243"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <!-- Inferior izquierda -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 195 376 L 195 414 L 146 414"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="195"
        cy="376"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <!-- Superior derecha -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 579 110 L 579 148 L 531 148"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="579"
        cy="110"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <!-- Central derecha -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 579 243 L 579 281 L 531 281"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="579"
        cy="243"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <!-- Inferior derecha -->
      <path
        class="control-line"
        d="M 579 376 L 579 414 L 531 414"
      />
      <circle
        class="control-node"
        cx="579"
        cy="376"
        r="3.5"
      />
    </g>

    <!--
      VÁLVULAS DE VAPOR

      Actuadores ovalados: rx=1.5, ry=6.5.
      Unión horizontal entre centros: 0.7 px.

      El borde derecho de cada óvalo queda en x=17,
      conservando la conexión con las líneas de control.
    -->
    <g class="valve-system">
      <!-- Superior izquierda -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(129 148)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Central izquierda -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(129 281)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Inferior izquierda -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(129 414)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Superior derecha -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(514 148)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Central derecha -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(514 281)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Inferior derecha -->
      <g
        class="valve valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(514 414)"
      >
        <line
          class="valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z" />
        <path class="valve-body" d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z" />

        <ellipse
          class="valve-dot"
          cx="15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- AGUA DESMINERALIZADA -->
    <g class="demin-water-system">
      <!--
        Válvula centrada en y=487:
        borde superior y=478 e inferior y=496.
        La tubería llega exactamente a esos bordes.
      -->
      <path
        class="demin-water-line valve-connection"
        d="M 428 376 L 428 478"
      />

      <circle
        class="demin-water-node"
        cx="428"
        cy="376"
        r="3.5"
      />

      <path
        class="demin-water-line valve-connection"
        d="M 428 496 L 428 504 L 504 504"
      />

      <!-- Agua desmineralizada: actuador situado a la izquierda -->
      <g
        class="demin-valve demin-valve-vertical"
        transform="translate(428 487)"
      >
        <line
          class="demin-valve-link"
          x1="0" y1="0"
          x2="-15.5" y2="0"
        />

        <path
          class="demin-valve-body"
          d="M -9 -9 L 9 -9 L 0 0 Z"
        />

        <path
          class="demin-valve-body"
          d="M -9 9 L 9 9 L 0 0 Z"
        />

        <ellipse
          class="demin-valve-dot"
          cx="-15.5"
          cy="0"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="6.5"
        />
      </g>      

      <!-- Recuadro original con acabado metálico -->
      <g class="demin-box-group">
        <rect
          class="demin-box"
          x="504"
          y="470"
          width="175"
          height="53"
          rx="6"
          ry="6"
        />

        <path
          class="tank-top-highlight"
          d="M 511 471.2 L 672 471.2"
        />

        <path
          class="tank-bottom-shade"
          d="M 511 521.8 L 672 521.8"
        />
      </g>

      <text
        class="demin-label"
        x="511"
        y="489"
      >Agua Desmineralizada</text>
    </g>

    <!-- CUERDA SUPERIOR: recorrido original íntegro -->
    <g class="fiber-system fiber-system-top">
      <path
        class="fiber"
        d="
          M 0 95
          L 655 95
          A 20 20 0 0 0 670.847 87.201
          L 719.360 24.189
          A 21 21 0 0 1 751.300 22.616
          L 813.429 88.699
          A 20 20 0 0 0 828 95
          L 866 95
        "
      />
    </g>

    <!-- CUERDA CENTRAL: recorrido original íntegro -->
    <g class="fiber-system fiber-system-middle">
      <path
        class="fiber"
        d="
          M 866 231
          L 828 231
          A 20 20 0 0 1 813.533 224.810
          L 751.190 159.500
          A 21 21 0 0 0 719.330 161.228
          L 671.876 223.164
          A 20 20 0 0 1 656 231
          L 0 231
        "
      />
    </g>

    <!-- CUERDA INFERIOR: recorrido original íntegro -->
    <g class="fiber-system fiber-system-bottom">
      <path
        class="fiber"
        d="
          M 0 319
          L 35.75 354.10
          A 21 21 0 0 0 50 365
          L 633 364
          L 654 364
          A 21 21 0 0 0 671.134 355.142
          L 718.238 288.673
          A 15 15 0 0 0 719.884 285.677
          L 715.487 296.431
          A 20 20 0 0 1 748.524 290.251
          L 811.476 356.749
          A 20 20 0 0 0 826 363
          L 866 363
        "
      />
    </g>

    <!--
      POLEAS

      Centros y radios originales.
      Sin anillos interiores.
      Borde de 2.2 px y acabado metálico.
    -->
    <g class="rollers">
      <!-- 25 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="655" cy="75" r="20" />
      </g>

      <!-- 26 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="736" cy="37" r="21" />
      </g>

      <!-- 27 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="828" cy="75" r="20" />
      </g>

      <!-- 40 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="828" cy="211" r="20" />
      </g>

      <!-- 41 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="736" cy="174" r="21" />
      </g>

      <!-- 42 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="656" cy="211" r="20" />
      </g>

      <!-- 67 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="50" cy="344" r="21" />
      </g>

      <!-- 71 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="654" cy="343" r="21" />
      </g>

      <!-- 73: conserva su radio menor -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="706" cy="280" r="15" />
      </g>

      <!-- 72 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="734" cy="304" r="20" />
      </g>

      <!-- 74 -->
      <g class="roller-unit">
        <circle class="roller-body" cx="826" cy="343" r="20" />
      </g>
